turn: Batch validation of a folder is done. I added `summarize` in `src/batch/summary.py`, which takes the (path, errors) results for each file and returns the paths of the files that failed along with a `failed_count`. A file counts as failed when its error list isn't empty, and every other file counts as passed. I checked it by reading through the logic against the result shape the batch runner produces. I did not run it against a real folder of invoices or add a test in this step, so that check is still open. In the same commit I also made one small fix I noticed along the way: the batch module had an unused import left over from an earlier refactor, and I removed it. Next I'll start on "Cache for parsed parties".

sidefix.title: Remove unused import in batch module
sidefix.what: Deleted a leftover unused import in the batch module that remained after an earlier refactor.
